records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net sales were $129.4 million for the three months ended September 30, 2024 compared to $144.1 million in the three months ended September 30, 2023, a decrease of $14.7 million, or 10.2%.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net sales were $425.0 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2024 compared to $433.9 million in the nine months ended September 30, 2023, a decrease of $8.9 million or 2.1%.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The decrease in sales for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2024 compared to the same period in 2023 is a result of low snowfall in our core markets leading to lower volumes in 2024.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The increase in sales for the three months ended September 30, 2024 compared to the same period in 2023 was a result of price increase realization, as well as higher sales of Company-purchased chassis, which are typically sold at cost.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net cash used in operating activities decreased $30.9 million from the nine months ended September 30, 2023 to the nine months ended September 30, 2024.
